unique_remaining_use_cases: Preflight caller-selected cross-task derived context cards against current local source bytes, version declarations, and caller-declared access scope before reuse.
claim_ceiling: The tool can refuse reuse when exact local source bytes or caller-declared access metadata do not match. It does not generate, persist, rank, or semantically validate derived cards, establish source authority or permission grants, or satisfy raw-evidence requirements.

limits: One deterministic synthetic workload; no model, provider, network, private source, or external evaluator.
RBEU is a byte/read proxy, not money, tokens, or general wall time; process overhead was not captured.
C was 11.41% above minimal A and had higher local per-task Python timing than A/B.
Duplicate unavailable-source gaps at h09 and x05 remained in the frozen B/C outputs.
The diagnostic D arm tests scorer detection; it does not prove real access-control safety.

contract_overlap.finding: Assembles one caller-selected packet of exact local excerpts, task obligations, and explicit gaps. It does not carry a derived card across tasks or preflight access-scope changes for cached context.
Uses the checked-out search index to find candidates and reopens bounded current raw files. It does not validate a caller-supplied derived cache card for reuse.
Renders a declared repository article-cluster inventory, not arbitrary task-facing derived context bound to a changing source and access scope.

local_comparison.method: Contract review, exact local implementation review, focused negative controls, and a bounded real local reuse task.
findings: This candidate only preflights reuse; it does not implement the full AB-20 card-generation or persistence mechanism.
The candidate hashes only explicit local source paths under ignition/ after caller-declared access is ACTIVE and authorized.
Source-scope grants, semantic relevance, and cached summary quality remain caller decisions and are not verified by the candidate.
The existing packet assembler, raw navigator, and cluster brief preserve distinct valuable contracts; no evidence supports their retirement or replacement.

disposition.action: Keep the candidate optional and default-off; do not retire or replace a neighboring tool. Revisit only with a same-task quality and measured-resource comparison using a naturally occurring cross-task reuse case.
